method: ENTIRELY from AMH's General principles: anticancer drugs page and its antiemetic table, read under subscription and PARAPHRASED: no passage reproduced, no source_text stored, so NOTHING here is machine re-checkable. ⚠️ ANTICANCER PRESCRIBING IS NOT A GENERAL-PRACTICE ACTIVITY AND THIS GUIDELINE DOES NOT PRETEND OTHERWISE -- AMH's own first substantive sentence is that these drugs should be provided only by appropriately trained, accredited and authorised staff. The guideline is scoped to what a non-oncologist encounters: recognising the toxicities in front of them, the safety rules that have killed people when broken, and the counselling. NO ANTICANCER DRUG IS DOSED.

claims.claim: Treatment of cancer is guided by STANDARD PROTOCOLS taking into account the type of cancer, stage at diagnosis, treatment history and patient characteristics; treatment that aims to CURE is usually MORE INTENSIVE than treatment that aims to control the cancer or relieve symptoms
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ANTICANCER DRUGS HAVE A NARROW THERAPEUTIC RANGE AND SHOULD BE PROVIDED ONLY BY APPROPRIATELY TRAINED, ACCREDITED AND AUTHORISED STAFF
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Indications listed in AMH's anticancer monographs are NOT COMPREHENSIVE and may include non-marketed uses; TREATMENT PROTOCOLS SHOULD ALWAYS BE CONSULTED
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: SCREEN ALL PATIENTS FOR HEPATITIS B, as there is a risk of REACTIVATION with anticancer drugs that cause myelo- or immunosuppression; seek specialist advice if positive as antiviral prophylaxis may be required, and MONITOR FOR CLINICAL AND LABORATORY SIGNS OF HEPATITIS DURING, AND FOR UP TO 12 MONTHS AFTER, TREATMENT
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Check for presence of infection before starting, and PERFORM A DENTAL EXAMINATION to manage potential sources of infection or irritation
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Immune response to INACTIVATED vaccines may be reduced during treatment with myelo- or immunosuppressive anticancer drugs, and MOST LIVE VACCINES ARE CONTRAINDICATED IN SEVERE IMMUNOSUPPRESSION -- due to treatment OR THE MALIGNANCY -- because of the risk of vaccine-related disease
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ALTHOUGH SOME ANTICANCER DRUGS ARE ASSOCIATED WITH INFERTILITY, IT IS STILL IMPORTANT TO ENSURE EFFECTIVE CONTRACEPTION -- INCLUDING FOR THE PARTNERS OF TREATED MALES -- during, and for a period after stopping, anticancer treatment; the length of time depends on the drug and its teratogenic potential, and contraception may also be continued to delay pregnancy until the risk of recurrence is lower
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Anticancer drugs are GENERALLY AVOIDED DURING THE FIRST TRIMESTER as they may increase the risk of MAJOR CONGENITAL MALFORMATIONS, ESTIMATED RISK 10 TO 20%, as well as miscarriage and fetal death -- though in some cases such as ACUTE LEUKAEMIA it may not be possible to delay treatment
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Treatment during the SECOND AND THIRD TRIMESTERS is generally considered acceptable as the risk of malformations does not appear to be increased, HOWEVER the risk of FETAL GROWTH RESTRICTION, LOW BIRTH WEIGHT AND STILLBIRTH may be increased
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: BREASTFEEDING IS GENERALLY NOT RECOMMENDED during anticancer treatment because of the possible risk of adverse effects in the infant; data are limited
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: MONITOR FOR FATIGUE REGULARLY AS IT OCCURS IN NEARLY EVERYONE treated with anticancer drugs or radiotherapy; consider treatable causes such as ANAEMIA, PAIN and DEPRESSION, and management may include exercise and psychosocial programs
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Myelosuppression affects red cells, white cells and platelets. RED CELLS LIVE 120 DAYS so anaemia does not usually occur until after repeated doses; NEUTROPHILS remain in the circulation UP TO 12 HOURS before migrating into tissues where they survive 1 TO 3 DAYS; PLATELETS live 7 TO 10 DAYS -- so WHITE CELLS AND PLATELETS ARE AFFECTED FIRST but generally recover rapidly
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Monitor the complete blood count during myelosuppressive treatment and watch for ANAEMIA (fatigue, dizziness, feeling faint, shortness of breath), THROMBOCYTOPENIA (bleeding or bruising) and the complications of NEUTROPENIA (infection or FEVER ABOVE 38.5 DEGREES CELSIUS); MYELOSUPPRESSION IS THE MOST COMMON REASON TO DELAY CHEMOTHERAPY AND REDUCE THE DOSAGE
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: G-CSFs may be used for PRIMARY prophylaxis in patients at high risk of febrile neutropenia, SECONDARY prophylaxis after a neutropenic complication in a previous cycle where dose reduction would compromise treatment, and RARELY as adjunctive treatment with anti-infectives in febrile neutropenia in patients at high risk of infection-related complications
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ERYTHROPOIETIN AGONISTS may relieve symptoms of chemotherapy-associated anaemia, HOWEVER THEY HAVE BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH REDUCED OVERALL SURVIVAL AND INCREASED RISK OF TUMOUR PROGRESSION IN SOME STUDIES; TRANSFUSION MAY BE PREFERRED, ESPECIALLY IN PATIENTS WITH A POTENTIALLY CURABLE CANCER
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: BROAD-SPECTRUM ANTIBACTERIALS, empirical initially, are indicated in FEBRILE NEUTROPENIA -- refer to local protocols; PROPHYLAXIS FOR PNEUMOCYSTIS JIROVECII PNEUMONIA may be indicated in haematological malignancies, some solid tumours, haemopoietic stem cell transplantation, and with selected chemotherapy regimens or PROLONGED, HIGH DOSES OF CORTICOSTEROIDS
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ACUTE chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting occurs in the FIRST 24 HOURS and generally peaks after 5 TO 6 HOURS; DELAYED occurs MORE THAN 24 HOURS after a dose and is common with CISPLATIN, CARBOPLATIN, CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE and DOXORUBICIN, with delayed vomiting due to cisplatin usually peaking after 48 TO 72 HOURS and lasting 6 TO 7 DAYS
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ANTICIPATORY nausea and vomiting occurs in patients who have had poor control with previous chemotherapy -- PREVENTION BY OPTIMAL ANTIEMETIC THERAPY IS IMPORTANT, with behavioural therapy and anxiolytics such as lorazepam as other treatments; BREAKTHROUGH nausea and vomiting occurs despite prophylaxis, and an antiemetic FROM A DIFFERENT CLASS should be considered
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: AMH's antiemetic bands by EMETOGENIC RISK for IV anticancer drugs: HIGH RISK above 90% requires pretreatment with a 5HT3 antagonist, DEXAMETHASONE and a substance P antagonist, with olanzapine optionally added, plus prophylaxis for delayed nausea; MODERATE RISK 30 to 90% requires dexamethasone and a 5HT3 antagonist; LOW RISK 10 to 30% requires dexamethasone, metoclopramide or a 5HT3 antagonist and no delayed prophylaxis; MINIMAL RISK below 10% requires no pretreatment unless there is a history of nausea and vomiting
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: For ORAL anticancer drugs, moderate-to-high emetogenic risk above 30% requires pretreatment with a 5HT3 antagonist, and minimal-to-low risk below 30% requires none unless there is a history of nausea and vomiting
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Persistent or severe DIARRHOEA can cause dehydration, electrolyte disturbances and renal insufficiency: consider fluid and electrolyte replacement and treat with LOPERAMIDE, or if severe or unresponsive OCTREOTIDE; consider withholding anticancer therapy until symptoms resolve, and future dose reduction or stopping may be required
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: MUCOSITIS may occur anywhere in the GI tract, from mild atrophy to severe ulceration with extreme pain, dry mouth, inability to swallow or speak, infection including bacteraemia, nausea, vomiting, GI bleeding and diarrhoea; severe or repeated episodes require dose reduction or stopping treatment
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: BASIC ORAL CARE -- soft toothbrush, flossing, salt or sodium bicarbonate mouthwashes -- is important for mucosal health ALTHOUGH NOT PROVEN TO PREVENT OR TREAT oral mucositis; chlorhexidine mouthwash may be used for anti-plaque and antifungal properties BUT EVIDENCE FOR PREVENTING ORAL MUCOSITIS IS CONFLICTING, and evidence of effectiveness for topical anaesthetics such as lidocaine 2% oral liquid is LACKING
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ORAL COOLING WITH ICE CHIPS DURING CHEMOTHERAPY ADMINISTRATION PREVENTS OR REDUCES ORAL MUCOSITIS in patients receiving BOLUS DOSES OF FLUOROURACIL OR HIGH-DOSE MELPHALAN; PALIFERMIN, available via the SAS, reduces severity and duration of severe oral mucositis in haematological cancer patients receiving high-dose chemotherapy and total body irradiation before stem cell transplant
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ALOPECIA can affect scalp, facial and body hair, is usually REVERSIBLE after treatment stops, and REGROWTH MAY OCCUR WITH HAIR OF DIFFERENT COLOUR AND TEXTURE; scalp cooling may be used with some drugs to reduce hair loss
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: HAND-FOOT SYNDROME, palmar-plantar erythrodysaesthesia, is most frequently associated with CAPECITABINE, DOXORUBICIN by continuous infusion or liposomal, CYTARABINE and FLUOROURACIL; it appears DOSE-DEPENDENT, PALMS ARE AFFECTED MORE THAN SOLES, and it presents with dysaesthesia progressing to swelling, pain, erythema and possibly desquamation, USUALLY RESOLVING WITHIN 2 WEEKS IF THE DRUG IS STOPPED. LOSS OF FINGERPRINTS HAS ALSO BEEN REPORTED WITH CAPECITABINE
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: A similar reaction occurs with some KINASE INHIBITORS such as sorafenib and sunitinib, however lesions affect the SOLES MORE THAN PALMS and tend to be more localised and hyperkeratotic; the most effective treatments for hand-foot syndrome are DOSE REDUCTION, INCREASING THE DOSING INTERVAL OR STOPPING THE DRUG
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: EGFR INHIBITORS such as cetuximab, erlotinib and gefitinib COMMONLY cause a PAPULOPUSTULAR RASH, usually on the face and upper body, WITHIN THE FIRST 2 TO 4 WEEKS; FOR SOME EGFR INHIBITORS THE OCCURRENCE AND/OR SEVERITY OF THE RASH MAY BE ASSOCIATED WITH IMPROVED RESPONSE OR SURVIVAL
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Other EGFR inhibitor skin effects include itch, dry skin and fissures, with PARONYCHIA, nail disorders and abnormal hair growth becoming apparent AFTER 1 TO 2 MONTHS; treatment of rash may include topical corticosteroids, topical antibacterials such as clindamycin, or oral antibacterials, and PROPHYLACTIC TETRACYCLINES SUCH AS DOXYCYCLINE HAVE BEEN TRIED BUT EVIDENCE IS CONFLICTING
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: TUMOUR LYSIS SYNDROME is caused by massive release of breakdown products from malignant cells, resulting in HYPERKALAEMIA, HYPERURICAEMIA, HYPERPHOSPHATAEMIA AND HYPOCALCAEMIA; uric acid may precipitate in the distal renal tubule and is the MOST COMMON CAUSE OF URAEMIA
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Tumour lysis syndrome is more common with some haematological malignancies such as acute leukaemias and non-Hodgkin lymphomas, with tumours of high proliferative rate, large burden or high sensitivity to the drug, WITH THE FIRST CYCLE OF CHEMOTHERAPY -- usually WITHIN 12 TO 72 HOURS after administration, although sometimes BEFORE chemotherapy -- and in patients with decreased urinary flow, pre-existing hyperuricaemia, renal impairment, dehydration or acidic urine
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: PREVENTION OF TUMOUR LYSIS SYNDROME IS IMPORTANT: increased hydration, sometimes with diuretics to maintain urine output, promotes urate and phosphate excretion; ALLOPURINOL STARTED BEFORE CHEMOTHERAPY prevents hyperuricaemia in at-risk patients, and RASBURICASE may be used in those unable to take allopurinol or at high risk; adequate hydration alone may be appropriate if risk is low
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: URINARY ALKALINISATION to promote urate excretion IS CONTROVERSIAL because of the risk of metabolic alkalosis, calcium phosphate precipitation and/or formation of urinary xanthine crystals
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: INFERTILITY can result from some anticancer drugs or radiotherapy and may be transient or permanent; ALKYLATING AGENTS HAVE THE HIGHEST RISK, reducing sperm count and causing ovarian failure. PRETREATMENT COUNSELLING about possible infertility and options for fertility preservation such as sperm or embryo cryopreservation may be appropriate, and effects on developing gonads may lead to infertility later in life
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: SOME ANTICANCER DRUGS AND RADIOTHERAPY ARE CARCINOGENIC: ALKYLATING AGENTS, PODOPHYLLOTOXINS AND ANTHRACYCLINES have been most frequently implicated, and secondary malignancies include MYELODYSPLASIA, ACUTE MYELOID LEUKAEMIA and some solid tumours
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Doses quoted in AMH for anticancer drugs are NOT COMPREHENSIVE and are included ONLY WHERE THE DOSE IS WELL ESTABLISHED; treatment protocols should be consulted as doses in single-agent versus combination therapy are OFTEN QUITE DIFFERENT AND PROTOCOLS MAY CHANGE FREQUENTLY
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Doses are often based on weight or BODY SURFACE AREA, HOWEVER FOR MANY ANTICANCER DRUGS ADJUSTING DOSES ACCORDING TO BSA DOES NOT REDUCE INTER-INDIVIDUAL PHARMACOKINETIC VARIABILITY IN ADULTS
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: When calculating body surface area: USE THE SAME CALCULATION METHOD, for example the MOSTELLER EQUATION, WITHIN A HOSPITAL; DO NOT USE PRINTED TABLES OR SLIDE-RULES; DO NOT CAP BSA, for example at 2 square metres; and USE ACTUAL WEIGHT IN OBESE PATIENTS, as alternative estimates of weight MAY RESULT IN UNDERDOSING
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: EXTRAVASATION -- inadvertent leakage of drug from a vein into surrounding tissue -- may cause no damage, pain and mild inflammation, or SEVERE ULCERATIVE NECROSIS; agents that cause damage are usually given VIA A CENTRAL VENOUS CATHETER, or by slow IV push or short infusion into the side-arm of a free-flowing IV infusion
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ONLY METHOTREXATE AND CYTARABINE CAN BE GIVEN BY THE INTRATHECAL ROUTE and they should be labelled 'For intrathecal use', with preservative-free diluents. INADVERTENT INTRATHECAL ADMINISTRATION OF OTHER ANTICANCER DRUGS HAS CAUSED DEATH -- in particular PARENTERAL VINCA ALKALOIDS SHOULD BE LABELLED 'FOR INTRAVENOUS USE ONLY -- FATAL IF GIVEN BY OTHER ROUTES'
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ONLY TRAINED PERSONNEL USING APPROVED EQUIPMENT AND CLOTHING SHOULD HANDLE HAZARDOUS DRUGS: these agents must not contact skin, mucosal or serosal surfaces during preparation and administration, and oral products must be handled to avoid skin contact, liberation of aerosols or powder, and cross-contamination with other medicines
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: Counsel patients that most anticancer drugs cause side effects, sometimes severe, that they may be prescribed other medicines to reduce or treat them, and that they should CHECK WITH THEIR CANCER SPECIALIST OR PHARMACIST BEFORE TAKING ANY OTHER MEDICINES INCLUDING OVER-THE-COUNTER, COMPLEMENTARY OR ALTERNATIVE MEDICINES; further information and support is available from the Cancer Council on 13 11 20
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'General principles: anticancer drugs' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/anticancer-drugs/general-principles-anticancer-drugs, July 2026 release, read under subscription 2026-09-22
